name: Bloglist Application
description: A full-stack web application for managing blog posts, user authentication, interactive features like liking and commenting, and fully automated testing and deployment pipelines.
features: User authentication and authorization using JWT
CRUD operations for blog posts with persistent like and comment functionality
Comprehensive test coverage including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
Automated CI/CD deployment pipeline with containerization

name: Patientor
description: A medical record management system designed for healthcare providers to track patient entries, medical diagnosis codes, and sensitive health histories with strict type safety.
features: Strict end-to-end type safety using TypeScript interfaces and types
Runtime request validation and data parsing using Zod schemas
Patient record navigation with detailed medical entry breakdowns
ICD-10 medical code lookup and classification system

name: Health App
description: A health metrics tracking application designed to monitor physical activities, nutrition data, and vital statistics with visual progress analytics.
features: Daily health activity monitoring and target goal tracking
Data visualization dashboards for health progress analysis
Secure API integration for real-time fitness data synchronization
Responsive user interface optimized across mobile and desktop devices
